title: Zelensky Says Ukraine Will Resume Russian Refinery Strikes, Defying Trump
summary_full: President Volodymyr Zelensky expressed overt frustration with the United States in an interview with The Financial Times. He had paused the strikes to comply with a demand from the United States.
